Fulton St is served by the J, A, C, 2 and 3 lines. The J runs north from Fulton St and stops at Chambers St, which the map joins by free transfer to Brooklyn Bridge-City Hall. So the trip is: board the J at Fulton St, ride one stop to Chambers St, then transfer on the joined connection to the 4/5/6 at Brooklyn Bridge-City Hall. That is one transfer and only about one intermediate stop. I did not fully check every alternative routing, but none of the other lines I traced from Fulton St reach Brooklyn Bridge-City Hall with a single transfer and fewer stops.

FINAL ANSWER: Chambers St
